lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the head, arranged in a semi-regular grid. The blobs increase in diameter and spacing as they progress posteriorly along the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like alignment particularly visible in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A labyrinthine pattern consisting of short, curvilinear high-intensity lines and elongated spots is visible in the region posterior to the eye and ventral to the primary lateral ridge.
